items.exampleEn: After three years together, Tom and Lily decided to break up.
items.exampleZh: 在一起三年後，Tom 和 Lily 決定分手。

items.exampleEn: Please don't bring up that topic at dinner.
items.exampleZh: 吃晚餐時請不要提起那個話題。

items.exampleEn: The boss called off the meeting at the last minute.
items.exampleZh: 老闆在最後一刻取消了會議。

items.exampleEn: Sorry for the noise. Please carry on with your work.
items.exampleZh: 抱歉吵到你們，請繼續工作。

items.exampleEn: The students carried out a simple experiment in class.
items.exampleZh: 學生們在課堂上進行了一個簡單的實驗。

items.exampleEn: Lisa came up with a great idea for the party.
items.exampleZh: Lisa 為派對想出了一個很棒的點子。

items.exampleEn: My brother figured out a way to fix the old radio.
items.exampleZh: 我的兄弟想出了修好那台舊收音機的辦法。

items.sentenceEn: We called the picnic off because nobody could come.
items.sentenceZh: 因為沒有人能來，我們取消了野餐。

items.audioEn: My grandparents brought me up, and we lived in a town by the sea.
items.audioZh: 我是爺爺奶奶養大的，我們住在一個海邊的小鎮。
items.questionZh: 說話的人小時候住在哪裡？
options: In a town near the ocean

items.sentenceEn: Carry on walking. We are almost there.
It took me an hour to figure this math problem out.
items.sentenceZh: 我花了一個小時才解出這道數學題。

items.stemEn: Last month, the team ____ a survey of 500 customers, and the results were very useful.
items.stemZh: 上個月，這個團隊對 500 位顧客進行了調查，結果非常有用。

items.stemEn: We need someone who can ____ a good name for our new shop.
items.stemZh: 我們需要一個能為新店想出好名字的人。

items.passageEn: Our class wanted to hold a music show for the school festival. But nobody could figure out how to pay for it. Then Kevin had a smart idea: we would sell cookies that we baked ourselves. My mom even bought big chocolate bars and helped us break them up for the cookies. Two weeks before the show, it rained for days, and the teachers almost called it off. However, the weather eventually got better, so we carried on. On the day of the show, we carried the plan out, and many parents came. Later, one teacher brought up the idea of holding the show every year.
items.passageZh: 我們班想在校慶時辦一場音樂表演。但是沒有人想得出要怎麼籌錢。後來 Kevin 有個聰明的點子：我們來賣自己烤的餅乾。我媽媽還買了大塊巧克力，幫我們把它們掰碎放進餅乾裡。表演前兩週，連續下了好幾天雨，老師們差點取消表演。不過天氣後來好轉，所以我們繼續進行。表演當天，我們照計畫執行，很多家長也來了。後來，一位老師提起每年都辦這場表演的想法。

questions.questionZh: 表演後，一位老師提起什麼想法？

items.promptZh: 我姊姊上個月和她男朋友分手了。
referenceEn: My sister broke up with her boyfriend last month.
My older sister broke up with her boyfriend last month.
Last month, my sister broke up with her boyfriend.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 broke up with 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 split up with、ended her relationship with 等）也算對
上個月的事用過去式（例如 broke up 等）
「姊姊」可寫，例如 sister、older sister、big sister 等

items.promptZh: 我還是弄不懂這個句子的意思。
referenceEn: I still can't figure out the meaning of this sentence.
I still can't figure out what this sentence means.
I still haven't figured out the meaning of this sentence.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 figure out the meaning、figure out what … means 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 understand、don't get 等）也算對
時態可用現在式或現在完成式（例如 can't figure out、don't understand、haven't figured out 等）
